name: Adrian Boafo
summary:
Adrian Asiedu Boafo ( BOW-ah-foe; born May 10, 1994) is an American politician who is the member-elect of the U.S. House of Representatives from Maryland's 5th congressional district. A member of the Democratic Party, he has served as a member of the Maryland House of Delegates from the 23rd district in Prince George's County, Maryland, since 2023.
Born in Virginia and raised in Maryland, Boafo graduated from the University of Baltimore and American University.
